notes: DR-optimized via 200 Dirichlet-sampled candidates. Core models (SASRec 65.9%, KAN 29.8%, Diffusion 2.4%, Quantum 1.0%) account for 99.1% of ensemble weight. Experimental models (LightGCN 0.5%, Hyperbolic 0.4%) are included for architectural diversity and will gain weight as online learning accumulates interaction data. Ensemble achieves +4.3% NDCG@10 lift over best individual model (SASRec).
